# Fexu documentation for AI assistants

> Fexu is a Rust web framework. Use documentation for the **exact release** a
> project depends on. As of 21 November 2026, 0.1.2 is published and 0.2.0
> is planned; development source on main is not a published release.
> Verify every copied Rust API against its version's source and tests.

## First steps

- [Documentation home](index.md): user-facing guide by topic
- [Documentation versions](documentation-versions.md): release selection and install commands
- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): install and run on Windows, Linux and macOS
- [First-project tutorial](tutorial-first-project.md): build Bookstore with settings, models, URLs, views, templates and admin
- [CLI reference](cli.md): all command families, subcommands, flags and examples
- [Project generator](project-generator.md): create projects and applications
- [Configuration](configuration.md): fexu.toml and environment variables

## Version and safety rules

- A page from `main` can describe an unreleased API. Do not present it as supported by published 0.1.2.
- Do not invent CLI commands, flags, Rust method names or configuration keys; match the release source.
- `fexu upgrade` handles supported project file layouts, not arbitrary Rust source rewrites or version-to-version DB upgrades.
- `fexu migrate plan` is read-only; `fexu migrate up` writes schema changes. Require a verified backup before migrations on existing data.
- PostgreSQL and SQLite have documented backend differences. Do not substitute one backend's SQL/DDL for the other.
- Generated applications require explicit access control; never presume all routes are automatically protected.
